open_jobs.job_description:
Join our dynamic startup as an Entry-Level Frontend Developer! Perfect for Computer Science graduates who love creating beautiful user interfaces and want to work with modern web technologies.

Responsibilities:
- Build responsive web applications using React and TypeScript
- Implement pixel-perfect designs from Figma mockups
- Write clean, reusable component code
- Optimize application performance
- Collaborate with designers and backend engineers
- Participate in daily standups and sprint planning
- Learn and adopt best practices in frontend development

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
- Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Familiarity with React or similar frameworks
- Basic knowledge of responsive design principles
- Git version control experience
- Portfolio or GitHub projects demonstrating frontend skills
- Passion for user experience and design
